newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index rises 3.59 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index rises 3.59 pct in late trade.

text.p: The Philippine share index gained 93.23 points, or 3.59 percent, to 2,691.43 points in late trade on Tuesday, buoyed by late buying on selected blue chips, traders said.
"As of the moment, we see blue chips which have reached bargain levels being accumulated," said Lawrence de Leon, analyst at Dharmala Securities Phils.
Traders said late buying in index heavyweights Ayala land Inc, Manila Electric Co B, aand Petron Corp buoyed up the main index.
Most of the active gainers earlier in the session were speculative issues.
Turnover was still modest at 1.08 billion pesos.
